children: Postal Realty Trust reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $30.3 million, up 24.5% from $24.3 million a year earlier, and net income attributable to common stockholders of $5.6 million, compared with $3.8 million. Diluted EPS was $0.16, versus $0.13 in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue was $30.3M, compared with $24.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 24.5%.
Net income attributable to common stockholders was $5.6M, compared with $3.8M; YoY change 47.1%.
Postal Realty acquired 243 USPS-leased properties for approximately $166.6 million during the first nine months of 2026, bringing its portfolio to 2,159 properties across 49 states and one territory.
Nine-month rental income increased 23.4% to $83.8 million, primarily reflecting acquisitions and annual rent escalations under new leases.
The portfolio had an average remaining lease term of approximately 5.5 years. USPS notified the company that it intends to vacate one property at lease end, which the company considered immaterial.
USPS network optimization could lead to facility closures, relocations or consolidations; the company reported no material operational or leasing impact to date.
After September 30 and through November 3, 2026, the company acquired 28 additional properties for approximately $11.1 million.
